_README: Example hook configuration for the Oppie persona system.
Why this lives here, not in .codesurf/settings.json:
src/hooks/config.ts deliberately ignores project-level hooks because a
malicious repo could otherwise execute arbitrary unsandboxed commands.
Hooks must be opted into per-machine via ~/.codesurf/user-settings.json.
2. Merge the `hooks` block below into your settings.
3. Replace <REPO> with the absolute path to this repo on your machine.
- SessionStart: prints HEARTBEAT.md to stderr so you see pending items at startup.
- UserPromptSubmit: nothing yet — wire here if you want a turn-counter.
- SessionEnd:   appends a one-line entry to MEMORY.md update log.
- Stop:         reminds you to run a DREAMING pass if the session was substantive.
Note: `additionalContext` outputs are NOT yet consumed by the agent loop;
these hooks are observability and side-effect hooks for now. Turn-based
context injection requires an agent.ts change tracked under HEARTBEAT phase 3.

hooks.command: echo '{"additionalContext":"Heartbeat: consider whether DREAMING.md or MEMORY.md needs an update before the next session."}'
